before:
name: Auto Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths-ignore:
      - '*.md'
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/cron.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/backup.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/restore.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/vps-setup.yml'

# Cancel in-progress deploy khi co push moi
concurrency:
  group: deploy
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  APP_DIR: /opt/webphoto

jobs:
  # ── Parallel typechecks ──
  typecheck-fe:
    name: Typecheck Frontend
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: photo-storage/package-lock.json
      - run: cd photo-storage && npm ci && npx vue-tsc --noEmit

  typecheck-be:
    name: Typecheck Backend
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: photo-storage/server/package-lock.json
      - run: cd photo-storage/server && npm ci && npx tsc --noEmit

  deploy:
    name: Deploy to VPS
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [typecheck-fe, typecheck-be]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Load config/env
        run: |
          while IFS= read -r line; do
            [[ -z "$line" || "$line" == \#* ]] && continue
            [[ "$line" == *=* ]] && echo "$line" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          done < config/env
          PASS=$(sed -n 's/^VPS_PASSWORD=//p' config/env)
          echo "SSHPASS=${PASS}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "Config loaded"

      - name: Detect changes
        id: changes
        run: |
          # Dung github.event.before thay HEAD~1 — chinh xac voi squash merge
          BEFORE="${{ github.event.before }}"
          if [ "$BEFORE" = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ] || [ -z "$BEFORE" ]; then
            DIFF="FULL"
          else
            DIFF=$(git diff --name-only "$BEFORE" "${{ github.sha }}" 2>/dev/null || echo "FULL")
          fi
          echo "Changed files:"
          echo "$DIFF" | head -20

          fe=false; be=false; infra=false; db=false; config=false

          if [ "$DIFF" = "FULL" ]; then
            fe=true; be=true; infra=true; db=true; config=true
          else
            echo "$DIFF" | grep -qE '^photo-storage/(src/|package|vite|index|tsconfig)' && fe=true
            echo "$DIFF" | grep -qE '^photo-storage/server/' && be=true
            echo "$DIFF" | grep -qE '^(docker-compose|infra/|nginx/|.*Dockerfile)' && infra=true
            echo "$DIFF" | grep -qE '^(db/|photo-storage/server/src/database/schema|photo-storage/server/drizzle)' && db=true
            echo "$DIFF" | grep -qE '^config/' && config=true
          fi

          echo "fe=$fe" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "be=$be" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "infra=$infra" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "db=$db" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "config=$config" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Changes: fe=$fe be=$be infra=$infra db=$db config=$config"

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: photo-storage/package-lock.json

      - name: Build Frontend
        if: steps.changes.outputs.fe == 'true'
        run: |
          cd photo-storage
          npm ci
          npm run build

      - name: Build Backend
        if: steps.changes.outputs.be == 'true'
        run: |
          cd photo-storage/server
          npm ci
          npm run build

      - name: Setup SSH with sshpass
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq sshpass mysql-client > /dev/null
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          ssh-keyscan -p ${{ env.VPS_PORT }} -H ${{ env.VPS_HOST }} >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null

      - name: Detect deploy mode
        id: detect
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"
          if sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "test -f ${APP_DIR}/docker-compose.prod.yml"; then
            echo "mode=update" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Deploy mode: UPDATE"
          else
            echo "mode=init" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Deploy mode: INIT (first-time)"
          fi

      # ══════════════════════════════════════════
      # FIRST-TIME DEPLOYMENT (all steps run)
      # ══════════════════════════════════════════
      - name: '[INIT] Upload full project to VPS'
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'init'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"

          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "mkdir -p ${APP_DIR}/{nginx/conf.d,photo-storage/server,scripts,db/changelog}"

          # Tar pipe: 1 compressed stream thay vi 20+ scp calls
          echo "  Uploading project files..."
          tar czf - \
            docker-compose.prod.yml \
            docker-compose.tunnel.yml \
            .env.example \
            nginx/nginx.conf \
            nginx/conf.d/bhquan.site.conf \
            nginx/conf.d/bhquan.store.conf \
            photo-storage/dist \
            photo-storage/server/dist \
            photo-storage/server/package.json \
            photo-storage/server/package-lock.json \
            photo-storage/server/Dockerfile \
            photo-storage/server/Dockerfile.worker \
            scripts/deploy.sh \
            scripts/ssl-init.sh \
            db/changelog 2>/dev/null | \
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "tar xzf - -C ${APP_DIR}/"
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Project upload failed"
            echo "Check: VPS disk space, SSH connection, tar integrity"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "[OK] Full project uploaded"

      - name: '[INIT] Upload config/env as .env'
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'init'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "mkdir -p ${APP_DIR}/config"
          sshpass -e scp -P $PORT config/env $VPS:${APP_DIR}/config/env
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "cp ${APP_DIR}/config/env ${APP_DIR}/.env && chmod 600 ${APP_DIR}/.env"
          echo "[OK] .env created"

      - name: '[INIT] Start shared infrastructure (MySQL + Redis)'
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'init'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"
          INFRA_DIR=/opt/infra

          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "mkdir -p ${INFRA_DIR}"
          sshpass -e scp -P $PORT infra/docker-compose.yml $VPS:${INFRA_DIR}/docker-compose.yml

          MYSQL_ROOT_PWD=$(grep '^MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=' config/env | cut -d= -f2-)
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "echo 'MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${MYSQL_ROOT_PWD}' > ${INFRA_DIR}/.env && chmod 600 ${INFRA_DIR}/.env"

          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "
            docker network create webphoto_backend 2>/dev/null || true
            docker network create vietnet_frontend 2>/dev/null || true
            docker rm -f photo-mysql photo-redis shared-mysql shared-redis 2>/dev/null || true

            cd ${INFRA_DIR}
            UP_OUT=\$(docker compose up -d 2>&1)
            UP_EXIT=\$?
            echo \"\$UP_OUT\"
            if [ \$UP_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
              echo 'ERROR: docker compose up failed'
              echo '=== Container status ==='
              docker ps -a --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}' | grep -E 'mysql|redis' || echo '(none)'
              echo '=== MySQL logs ==='
              docker logs shared-mysql --tail 20 2>&1 || true
              echo '=== Redis logs ==='
              docker logs shared-redis --tail 10 2>&1 || true
              exit 1
            fi

            echo 'Waiting for MySQL...'
            for i in \$(seq 1 60); do
              if docker exec shared-mysql mysqladmin ping -h localhost --silent 2>/dev/null; then
                echo 'MySQL ready!'
                break
              fi
              if [ \$i -eq 60 ]; then
                echo 'ERROR: MySQL not ready after 60s'
                docker logs shared-mysql --tail 20
                exit 1
              fi
              sleep 1
            done
          "
          echo "[OK] Infra started"

      - name: '[INIT] Create WebPhoto DB + user'
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'init'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"
          MYSQL_ROOT_PWD=$(grep '^MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=' config/env | cut -d= -f2-)
          MYSQL_PWD=$(grep '^MYSQL_PASSWORD=' config/env | cut -d= -f2-)

          OUTPUT=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker exec -i shared-mysql mysql -u root -p'${MYSQL_ROOT_PWD}' <<EOSQL
            CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS photo_storage CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
            CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'photo_user'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '${MYSQL_PWD}';
            GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON *.* TO 'photo_user'@'%';
            FLUSH PRIVILEGES;
          EOSQL" 2>&1)
          EXIT_CODE=$?
          echo "$OUTPUT"
          if [ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Failed to create DB/user (exit=$EXIT_CODE)"
            echo "=== MySQL container status ==="
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker ps -a --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}' | grep mysql" 2>&1
            echo "=== MySQL logs ==="
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker logs shared-mysql --tail 15 2>&1"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "[OK] DB + user created"

      - name: '[INIT] Generate placeholder SSL certs'
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'init'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"

          # Tao self-signed placeholder certs de nginx start duoc voi full SSL config
          # Cert that se duoc lay sau khi health check pass
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "
            cd ${APP_DIR}
            for DOMAIN in bhquan.site bhquan.store; do
              CERT_EXISTS=\$(docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm --entrypoint '' certbot \
                test -f /etc/letsencrypt/live/\${DOMAIN}/fullchain.pem 2>/dev/null && echo yes || echo no)
              if [ \"\$CERT_EXISTS\" = 'no' ]; then
                echo \"Generating placeholder cert for \${DOMAIN}...\"
                docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm --entrypoint '' certbot sh -c \"
                  mkdir -p /etc/letsencrypt/live/\${DOMAIN}
                  openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 1 -newkey rsa:2048 \
                    -keyout /etc/letsencrypt/live/\${DOMAIN}/privkey.pem \
                    -out /etc/letsencrypt/live/\${DOMAIN}/fullchain.pem \
                    -subj '/CN=\${DOMAIN}' 2>/dev/null
                \"
                echo \"  OK\"
              else
                echo \"\${DOMAIN}: cert exists\"
              fi
            done
          "
          echo "[OK] SSL placeholders ready"

      - name: '[INIT] Build & Start all services'
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'init'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"

          echo "--- Building images ---"
          BUILD_OUT=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "cd ${APP_DIR} && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml build api worker 2>&1")
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Docker build failed"
            echo "$BUILD_OUT" | tail -30
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "--- Starting services ---"
          START_OUT=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "cd ${APP_DIR} && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d 2>&1")
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: docker compose up failed"
            echo "$START_OUT"
            echo ""
            echo "=== Container status ==="
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker ps -a --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}' | grep -E 'photo|shared'" 2>&1
            echo ""
            echo "=== API logs ==="
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "cd ${APP_DIR} && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs --tail 30 --no-color" 2>&1
            exit 1
          fi

          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}' | head -15"
          echo "[OK] All services started"

      - name: '[INIT] Get real SSL certs + reload nginx'
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'init'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"

          # Helper: xoa ALL cert files (bao gom -0001 variants) roi certbot certonly
          # Neu certbot fail → tao lai placeholder de nginx khong crash
          CERTBOT_HELPER='
            get_real_cert() {
              local D=$1; shift
              local DC="docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml"
              cd /opt/webphoto

              echo "  Cleaning old certs for $D..."
              $DC run --rm --entrypoint "" certbot sh -c "
                rm -rf /etc/letsencrypt/live/${D}* /etc/letsencrypt/archive/${D}* /etc/letsencrypt/renewal/${D}*.conf
              "

              echo "  Requesting cert for $D..."
              timeout 120 $DC run --rm --entrypoint "" certbot \
                certbot certonly --webroot -w /var/www/certbot \
                --non-interactive --cert-name $D \
                --email admin@bhquan.site --agree-tos --no-eff-email \
                "$@"

              if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
                echo "  FAILED — regenerating placeholder so nginx can start..."
                $DC run --rm --entrypoint "" certbot sh -c "
                  mkdir -p /etc/letsencrypt/live/$D
                  openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 1 -newkey rsa:2048 \
                    -keyout /etc/letsencrypt/live/$D/privkey.pem \
                    -out /etc/letsencrypt/live/$D/fullchain.pem \
                    -subj /CN=$D 2>/dev/null
                "
                return 1
              fi
              return 0
            }
          '

          # bhquan.site (timeout 120s)
          echo "--- Certbot: bhquan.site ---"
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "
            ${CERTBOT_HELPER}
            get_real_cert bhquan.site -d bhquan.site -d api.bhquan.site -d ws.bhquan.site
          " && echo "[OK] bhquan.site cert" || echo "WARNING: bhquan.site cert failed"

          # bhquan.store
          echo "--- Certbot: bhquan.store ---"
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "
            if docker ps --filter name=vietnet-api --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q vietnet-api 2>/dev/null; then
              ${CERTBOT_HELPER}
              get_real_cert bhquan.store -d bhquan.store -d www.bhquan.store
            else
              echo 'VietNet not running — skip bhquan.store'
            fi
          " 2>&1 || true

          # Reload nginx
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "
            docker exec shared-nginx nginx -t 2>&1 && \
            docker exec shared-nginx nginx -s reload && \
            echo '[OK] Nginx reloaded with SSL' || \
            echo 'WARNING: Nginx reload failed'
          "

      # ══════════════════════════════════════════
      # UPDATE DEPLOYMENT — conditional per change
      # ══════════════════════════════════════════
      - name: '[UPDATE] Upload frontend dist'
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'update' && steps.changes.outputs.fe == 'true'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "rm -rf ${APP_DIR}/photo-storage/dist"
          tar czf - photo-storage/dist | sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "tar xzf - -C ${APP_DIR}/"
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Frontend upload failed"
            echo "Check: VPS disk space, SSH connection, tar integrity"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "[OK] Frontend dist uploaded"

      - name: '[UPDATE] Upload backend dist'
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'update' && steps.changes.outputs.be == 'true'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "rm -rf ${APP_DIR}/photo-storage/server/dist"
          tar czf - photo-storage/server/dist \
            photo-storage/server/package.json \
            photo-storage/server/package-lock.json \
            photo-storage/server/Dockerfile \
            photo-storage/server/Dockerfile.worker | \
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "tar xzf - -C ${APP_DIR}/"
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Backend upload failed"
            echo "Check: VPS disk space, SSH connection, tar integrity"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "[OK] Backend dist uploaded"

      - name: '[UPDATE] Sync deploy config'
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'update'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"
          sshpass -e scp -P $PORT docker-compose.prod.yml $VPS:${APP_DIR}/

      - name: '[UPDATE] Sync Nginx config'
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'update'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"

          # Upload all nginx configs
          tar czf - nginx/conf.d/ | sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "tar xzf - -C ${APP_DIR}/" 2>/dev/null && {
            # Ensure placeholder certs exist before reloading
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "
              cd ${APP_DIR}
              for DOMAIN in bhquan.site bhquan.store; do
                CERT_EXISTS=\$(docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm --entrypoint '' certbot \
                  test -f /etc/letsencrypt/live/\${DOMAIN}/fullchain.pem 2>/dev/null && echo yes || echo no)
                if [ \"\$CERT_EXISTS\" = 'no' ]; then
                  echo \"Placeholder cert for \${DOMAIN}...\"
                  docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm --entrypoint '' certbot sh -c \"
                    mkdir -p /etc/letsencrypt/live/\${DOMAIN}
                    openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 1 -newkey rsa:2048 \
                      -keyout /etc/letsencrypt/live/\${DOMAIN}/privkey.pem \
                      -out /etc/letsencrypt/live/\${DOMAIN}/fullchain.pem \
                      -subj '/CN=\${DOMAIN}' 2>/dev/null
                  \"
                fi
              done
              docker exec shared-nginx nginx -t 2>&1 | tail -1 && docker exec shared-nginx nginx -s reload
            "
            echo "[OK] Nginx updated"
          } || echo "Nginx unchanged (skip)"

      - name: '[UPDATE] Sync shared infra'
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'update' && steps.changes.outputs.infra == 'true'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"
          INFRA_DIR=/opt/infra

          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "mkdir -p ${INFRA_DIR}"
          sshpass -e scp -P $PORT infra/docker-compose.yml $VPS:${INFRA_DIR}/docker-compose.yml
          MYSQL_ROOT_PWD=$(grep '^MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=' config/env | cut -d= -f2-)
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "echo 'MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${MYSQL_ROOT_PWD}' > ${INFRA_DIR}/.env && chmod 600 ${INFRA_DIR}/.env"
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "
            docker network create webphoto_backend 2>/dev/null || true
            docker network create vietnet_frontend 2>/dev/null || true
            docker rm -f photo-mysql photo-redis 2>/dev/null || true

            cd ${INFRA_DIR}
            UP_OUT=\$(docker compose up -d --force-recreate 2>&1)
            UP_EXIT=\$?
            echo \"\$UP_OUT\"
            if [ \$UP_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
              echo 'ERROR: docker compose up --force-recreate failed'
              echo '=== Container status ==='
              docker ps -a --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}' | grep -E 'mysql|redis' || echo '(none)'
              echo '=== MySQL logs ==='
              docker logs shared-mysql --tail 20 2>&1 || true
              echo '=== Redis logs ==='
              docker logs shared-redis --tail 10 2>&1 || true
              echo '=== Disk space ==='
              df -h / | tail -1
              exit 1
            fi

            echo 'Waiting for MySQL...'
            for i in \$(seq 1 60); do
              if docker exec shared-mysql mysqladmin ping -h localhost --silent 2>/dev/null; then
                echo 'MySQL ready!'
                break
              fi
              if [ \$i -eq 60 ]; then
                echo 'ERROR: MySQL not ready after 60s'
                docker logs shared-mysql --tail 20 2>&1 || true
                exit 1
              fi
              sleep 1
            done
          "
          echo "[OK] Infra synced"

      - name: '[UPDATE] Rebuild API containers'
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'update' && (steps.changes.outputs.be == 'true' || steps.changes.outputs.infra == 'true')
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"

          echo "--- Building api + worker ---"
          BUILD_OUT=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "cd ${APP_DIR} && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml build api worker 2>&1")
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Docker build failed"
            echo "$BUILD_OUT" | tail -30
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "--- Restarting api + worker + nginx ---"
          UP_OUT=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "cd ${APP_DIR} && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d api worker nginx 2>&1")
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: docker compose up failed"
            echo "$UP_OUT"
            echo ""
            echo "=== Container status ==="
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker ps -a --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}' | grep -E 'photo|shared'" 2>&1
            echo ""
            echo "=== API logs ==="
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "cd ${APP_DIR} && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs api --tail 30 --no-color" 2>&1
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "--- Verifying containers ---"
          sleep 3
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}' | grep -E 'photo|shared'" 2>&1
          echo "[OK] API containers rebuilt"

      - name: '[UPDATE] Restart API (FE-only change)'
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'update' && steps.changes.outputs.fe == 'true' && steps.changes.outputs.be != 'true' && steps.changes.outputs.infra != 'true'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"
          # FE dist duoc serve boi nginx — restart api + nginx de pick up new files
          OUTPUT=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "cd ${APP_DIR} && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d nginx && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml restart api 2>&1")
          EC=$?
          echo "$OUTPUT"
          if [ $EC -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Restart failed (exit=$EC)"
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker ps -a --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}' | grep -E 'photo|shared'" 2>&1
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "cd ${APP_DIR} && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs api --tail 15 --no-color" 2>&1
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "[OK] API + Nginx restarted (FE-only change, no rebuild)"

      # ══════════════════════════════════════════
      # SHARED STEPS (both init and update)
      # ══════════════════════════════════════════
      - name: Sync config/env to .env on VPS
        if: steps.changes.outputs.config == 'true' || steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'init'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "mkdir -p ${APP_DIR}/config"
          sshpass -e scp -P $PORT config/env $VPS:${APP_DIR}/config/env
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "cp ${APP_DIR}/config/env ${APP_DIR}/.env && chmod 600 ${APP_DIR}/.env"
          echo "[OK] config/env synced"

      - name: Ensure DB + user exist
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"

          if [ -z "$MYSQL_STATUS" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: shared-mysql not running!"
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker ps -a --filter name=mysql --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}'"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "  $MYSQL_STATUS"

          echo "--- Ensuring DB + user ---"
          OUTPUT=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker exec -i shared-mysql mysql -u root -p'${MYSQL_ROOT_PWD}' <<EOSQL
            CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS photo_storage CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
            CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'photo_user'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '${MYSQL_PWD}';
            GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON *.* TO 'photo_user'@'%';
            FLUSH PRIVILEGES;
          EOSQL" 2>&1)
          EXIT_CODE=$?
          if [ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Failed (exit=$EXIT_CODE)"
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "--- Verifying connection ---"
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker exec -i shared-mysql mysql -u photo_user -p'${MYSQL_PWD}' photo_storage -e 'SELECT DATABASE() AS db'" 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: connection failed"; exit 1; }
          echo "[OK] DB + user verified"

      - name: Ensure DB schema (drizzle push)
        if: steps.changes.outputs.db == 'true' || steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'init'
        run: |
          set +e
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"
          MYSQL_PWD=$(grep '^MYSQL_PASSWORD=' config/env | cut -d= -f2-)

          # SSH tunnel to MySQL
          MYSQL_IP=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' shared-mysql" 2>&1)
          echo "  MySQL IP: $MYSQL_IP"

          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT -L 13306:${MYSQL_IP}:3306 -N $VPS &
          TUNNEL_PID=$!
          sleep 2

          if ! mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -P 13306 -u photo_user -p"${MYSQL_PWD}" -e "SELECT 1" 2>&1; then
            echo "ERROR: SSH tunnel failed"
            kill $TUNNEL_PID 2>/dev/null
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "  Tunnel OK"

          echo "--- drizzle-kit push --force ---"
          cd photo-storage/server
          DATABASE_URL="mysql://photo_user:${MYSQL_PWD}@127.0.0.1:13306/photo_storage" npx drizzle-kit push --force 2>&1
          PUSH_EXIT=$?
          cd ../..
          kill $TUNNEL_PID 2>/dev/null

          if [ $PUSH_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: drizzle-kit push failed (exit=$PUSH_EXIT)"
            echo ""
            echo "=== MySQL connection test ==="
            mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -P 13306 -u photo_user -p"${MYSQL_PWD}" -e "SELECT DATABASE(), VERSION()" 2>&1 || echo "MySQL unreachable"
            echo ""
            echo "=== Current tables ==="
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker exec -i shared-mysql mysql -u photo_user -p'${MYSQL_PWD}' photo_storage -N -e 'SHOW TABLES'" 2>&1
            kill $TUNNEL_PID 2>/dev/null
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "--- Verifying tables ---"
          TABLES=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker exec -i shared-mysql mysql -u photo_user -p'${MYSQL_PWD}' photo_storage -N -e 'SHOW TABLES'" 2>&1)
          TABLE_COUNT=$(echo "$TABLES" | grep -c '[a-z]' || echo 0)
          echo "  Tables ($TABLE_COUNT): $(echo "$TABLES" | tr '\n' ', ' | sed 's/,$//')"
          if [ "$TABLE_COUNT" -lt 5 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Expected 14+ tables, found $TABLE_COUNT"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "[OK] Schema ($TABLE_COUNT tables)"

      - name: Wait for API container ready
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"
          echo "Waiting for api container..."
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            STATUS=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' photo-api 2>/dev/null" 2>&1)
            if [ "$STATUS" = "running" ]; then
              echo "  API container running (${i}s)"
              sleep 2
              break
            fi
            if [ $i -eq 30 ]; then
              echo "ERROR: API container not running after 30s (status=$STATUS)"
              echo ""
              echo "=== Container status ==="
              sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker ps -a --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}' | grep -E 'photo|shared'" 2>&1
              echo ""
              echo "=== API logs ==="
              sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "cd ${APP_DIR} && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs api --tail 30 --no-color" 2>&1
              echo ""
              echo "=== Worker logs ==="
              sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "cd ${APP_DIR} && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs worker --tail 15 --no-color" 2>&1
              echo ""
              echo "=== Redis policy ==="
              sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "docker exec shared-redis redis-cli CONFIG GET maxmemory-policy" 2>&1
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Seed database (INIT only)
        if: steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'init'
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"

          echo "Waiting for API to be ready..."
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "curl -sf http://localhost:4000/api/health" > /dev/null 2>&1 && break
            [ $i -eq 30 ] && { echo "API not ready — skip seed"; exit 0; }
            sleep 2
          done

          echo "Seeding (first-time only)..."
          OUTPUT=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "
            cd ${APP_DIR}
            docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec -T api node dist/database/seed.js 2>&1
          " 2>&1)
          EXIT_CODE=$?
          echo "$OUTPUT"
          if [ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "WARNING: Seed exit=$EXIT_CODE (non-blocking — data may already exist)"
          else
            echo "[OK] Seed complete"
          fi

      - name: Run DB Changelog
        if: steps.changes.outputs.db == 'true' || steps.detect.outputs.mode == 'init'
        run: |
          set +e
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"

          if [ ! -d "db/changelog" ]; then
            echo "No changelog directory (skip)"
            exit 0
          fi

          MYSQL_PWD=$(grep '^MYSQL_PASSWORD=' config/env | cut -d= -f2-)
          MYSQL_CMD="docker exec -i shared-mysql mysql -u photo_user -p${MYSQL_PWD} photo_storage"

          echo "[1/3] _init scripts..."
          for f in $(find db/changelog/_init -name '*.sql' -type f 2>/dev/null | sort); do
            INIT_OUT=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "$MYSQL_CMD" < "$f" 2>&1)
            INIT_EXIT=$?
            if [ $INIT_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
              echo "  $(basename $f) WARN: exit=$INIT_EXIT"
              echo "$INIT_OUT" | tail -3 | sed 's/^/    /'
            else
              echo "  $(basename $f) OK"
            fi
          done

          echo "[2/3] Checking applied..."
          APPLIED=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "$MYSQL_CMD -N -e \"SELECT CONCAT(version, '/', filename) FROM schema_changelog\"" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          echo "  Applied: $(echo "$APPLIED" | tr '\n' ', ' | sed 's/,$//' || echo 'none')"

          echo "[3/3] Running migrations..."
          PASS=0; SKIP=0; FAIL=0

          for ver_dir in $(find db/changelog -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name '_init' | sort); do
            VER=$(basename "$ver_dir")
            echo "── $VER ──"

            for f in $(find "$ver_dir" -name '*.sql' -type f | sort); do
              FNAME=$(basename "$f")
              KEY="${VER}/${FNAME}"

              if echo "$APPLIED" | grep -qF "$KEY"; then
                echo "  $FNAME SKIP"
                ((SKIP++)); continue
              fi

              echo -n "  $FNAME ... "
              START_MS=$(date +%s%N)
              OUTPUT=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "$MYSQL_CMD" < "$f" 2>&1)
              EXIT_CODE=$?
              END_MS=$(date +%s%N)
              DURATION_MS=$(( (END_MS - START_MS) / 1000000 ))

              if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then
                DESC=$(echo "$FNAME" | sed 's/^[0-9]*__//; s/\.sql$//; s/_/ /g')
                CHECKSUM=$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)
                sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $VPS "$MYSQL_CMD -e \"REPLACE INTO schema_changelog (version, filename, description, applied_by, checksum, execution_ms) VALUES ('$VER', '$FNAME', '$DESC', 'ci', '$CHECKSUM', $DURATION_MS)\"" 2>/dev/null
                echo "OK (${DURATION_MS}ms)"
                ((PASS++))
              else
                echo "FAILED (exit=$EXIT_CODE)"
                echo "$OUTPUT" | sed 's/^/    /'
                ((FAIL++))
              fi
            done
          done

          echo "Changelog: $PASS applied, $SKIP skipped, $FAIL failed"
          if [ $FAIL -gt 0 ]; then exit 1; fi

      - name: Health Check
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"
          SSH_OPTS="-o ConnectTimeout=10 -o ServerAliveInterval=5 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3"

          # Test SSH truoc khi health check
          echo "Testing SSH connection..."
          if ! sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $SSH_OPTS $VPS "echo SSH_OK" 2>&1; then
            echo "ERROR: SSH connection failed (exit=$?)"
            echo "VPS=$VPS PORT=$PORT"
            echo "Trying verbose SSH for diagnostics..."
            sshpass -e ssh -v -p $PORT $SSH_OPTS $VPS "echo SSH_OK" 2>&1 || true
            exit 1
          fi

          # Ensure placeholder SSL certs exist so nginx can start
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $SSH_OPTS $VPS "
            cd ${APP_DIR}
            for DOMAIN in bhquan.site bhquan.store; do
              CERT_EXISTS=\$(docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm --entrypoint '' certbot \
                test -f /etc/letsencrypt/live/\${DOMAIN}/fullchain.pem 2>/dev/null && echo yes || echo no)
              if [ \"\$CERT_EXISTS\" = 'no' ]; then
                echo \"Generating placeholder cert for \${DOMAIN}...\"
                docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm --entrypoint '' certbot sh -c \"
                  mkdir -p /etc/letsencrypt/live/\${DOMAIN}
                  openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 1 -newkey rsa:2048 \
                    -keyout /etc/letsencrypt/live/\${DOMAIN}/privkey.pem \
                    -out /etc/letsencrypt/live/\${DOMAIN}/fullchain.pem \
                    -subj '/CN=\${DOMAIN}' 2>/dev/null
                \"
              fi
            done
          " 2>&1 || true

          # Ensure nginx is running
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $SSH_OPTS $VPS "cd ${APP_DIR} && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d nginx 2>&1" || true

          # Ensure Redis noeviction policy
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $SSH_OPTS $VPS "
            POLICY=\$(docker exec shared-redis redis-cli CONFIG GET maxmemory-policy 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
            if [ \"\$POLICY\" != 'noeviction' ]; then
              echo 'Fixing Redis eviction policy...'
              docker exec shared-redis redis-cli CONFIG SET maxmemory-policy noeviction
              docker exec shared-redis redis-cli CONFIG REWRITE 2>/dev/null || true
              echo 'Redis policy set to noeviction'
            fi
          " 2>&1 || true

          echo "Waiting for API health..."
          set +e
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            RESULT=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $SSH_OPTS $VPS "docker exec photo-api node -e \"fetch('http://localhost:4000/api/health').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>{process.stdout.write(t);process.exit(0)}).catch(()=>process.exit(1))\"" 2>&1)
            SSH_EXIT=$?
            if [ $SSH_EXIT -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$RESULT" ]; then
              echo "API healthy (attempt $i): $RESULT"
              echo "Deploy successful! (mode=${{ steps.detect.outputs.mode }}, fe=${{ steps.changes.outputs.fe }}, be=${{ steps.changes.outputs.be }}, infra=${{ steps.changes.outputs.infra }})"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "  attempt $i: ssh_exit=$SSH_EXIT result='$RESULT'"
            sleep 2
          done

          echo ""
          echo "ERROR: Health check failed after 30s"
          echo "Last response: $RESULT"

          # Diagnostics — gom vao 1 SSH call duy nhat de tranh connection exhaustion
          echo ""
          echo "=== DIAGNOSTICS (single SSH call) ==="
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $SSH_OPTS $VPS "
            echo '--- Container status ---'
            docker ps -a --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}' | grep -E 'photo|shared' || echo '(no containers found)'

            echo ''
            echo '--- API logs (last 50) ---'
            cd ${APP_DIR} && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs api --tail 50 --no-color 2>&1 || echo '(failed to get API logs)'

            echo ''
            echo '--- Worker logs (last 15) ---'
            docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs worker --tail 15 --no-color 2>&1 || echo '(failed to get worker logs)'

            echo ''
            echo '--- Curl verbose ---'
            curl -v http://localhost:4000/api/health 2>&1 || echo '(curl failed)'

            echo ''
            echo '--- Redis check ---'
            docker exec shared-redis redis-cli CONFIG GET maxmemory-policy 2>&1 || echo '(redis unreachable)'

            echo ''
            echo '--- Docker networks ---'
            docker network ls | grep -E 'webphoto|vietnet' || echo '(no networks)'

            echo ''
            echo '--- Disk/Memory ---'
            df -h / | tail -1
            free -h | head -2
          " 2>&1 || echo "WARNING: Diagnostic SSH call also failed (exit=$?)"
          exit 1

      - name: Ensure SSL Certificates
        run: |
          VPS="${{ env.VPS_USER }}@${{ env.VPS_HOST }}"
          PORT="${{ env.VPS_PORT }}"
          SSH_OPTS="-o ConnectTimeout=10 -o ServerAliveInterval=5 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3"

          # Check if real cert exists (not self-signed placeholder)
          CERT_INFO=$(sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $SSH_OPTS $VPS "
            cd ${APP_DIR}
            docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm --entrypoint '' certbot sh -c '
              CERT=/etc/letsencrypt/live/bhquan.site/fullchain.pem
              if [ ! -f \$CERT ]; then echo MISSING; exit 0; fi
              ISSUER=\$(openssl x509 -in \$CERT -noout -issuer 2>/dev/null)
              if echo \$ISSUER | grep -qi \"let.s encrypt\\|R3\\|R10\\|R11\\|E5\\|E6\"; then
                echo REAL
              else
                echo PLACEHOLDER
              fi
            '
          " 2>&1)

          echo "Cert status: $CERT_INFO"

          if echo "$CERT_INFO" | grep -q "REAL"; then
            echo "Real SSL cert exists — skip Certbot"
          else
            echo "Requesting real SSL certs via Certbot (timeout 120s)..."

            CERTBOT_HELPER='
              get_real_cert() {
                local D=$1; shift
                local DC="docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml"
                cd /opt/webphoto
                echo "  Cleaning old certs for $D..."
                $DC run --rm --entrypoint "" certbot sh -c "
                  rm -rf /etc/letsencrypt/live/${D}* /etc/letsencrypt/archive/${D}* /etc/letsencrypt/renewal/${D}*.conf
                "
                echo "  Requesting cert for $D..."
                timeout 120 $DC run --rm --entrypoint "" certbot \
                  certbot certonly --webroot -w /var/www/certbot \
                  --non-interactive --cert-name $D \
                  --email admin@bhquan.site --agree-tos --no-eff-email \
                  "$@"
                if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
                  echo "  FAILED — regenerating placeholder..."
                  $DC run --rm --entrypoint "" certbot sh -c "
                    mkdir -p /etc/letsencrypt/live/$D
                    openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 1 -newkey rsa:2048 \
                      -keyout /etc/letsencrypt/live/$D/privkey.pem \
                      -out /etc/letsencrypt/live/$D/fullchain.pem \
                      -subj /CN=$D 2>/dev/null
                  "
                  return 1
                fi
              }
            '

            # bhquan.site
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $SSH_OPTS $VPS "
              ${CERTBOT_HELPER}
              get_real_cert bhquan.site -d bhquan.site -d api.bhquan.site -d ws.bhquan.site
            " 2>&1 && echo "[OK] bhquan.site cert" || echo "WARNING: bhquan.site cert failed"

            # bhquan.store
            sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $SSH_OPTS $VPS "
              if docker ps --filter name=vietnet-api --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q vietnet-api 2>/dev/null; then
                ${CERTBOT_HELPER}
                get_real_cert bhquan.store -d bhquan.store -d www.bhquan.store
              else
                echo 'VietNet not running — skip bhquan.store'
              fi
            " 2>&1 || true
          fi

          # Reload nginx with certs
          sshpass -e ssh -p $PORT $SSH_OPTS $VPS "
            docker exec shared-nginx nginx -t 2>&1
            if [ \$? -eq 0 ]; then
              docker exec shared-nginx nginx -s reload
              echo '[OK] Nginx reloaded'
            else
              echo 'ERROR: Nginx config test failed'
              docker exec shared-nginx nginx -T 2>&1 | tail -20
            fi
          " 2>&1

### 5. Nginx + SSL

#### Đường dẫn config theo loại Nginx

| Loại | Config path | Reload command |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| **BT Panel / aaPanel** | `/www/server/panel/vhost/nginx/<domain>.conf` | `nginx -s reload` |

| **conf.d** | `/etc/nginx/conf.d/<domain>.conf` | `nginx -s reload` |

#### Nội dung Nginx config

```nginx
# HTTP → HTTPS redirect
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name <DOMAIN> www.<DOMAIN>;

    location /.well-known/acme-challenge/ {
        root /opt/webphoto/photo-storage/dist;
    }
    location / {
        return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
    }
}

# HTTPS
server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name <DOMAIN> www.<DOMAIN>;

    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/<DOMAIN>/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/<DOMAIN>/privkey.pem;
    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
    ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;
    ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;

    root /opt/webphoto/photo-storage/dist;
    index index.html;

    # API proxy — tất cả upload đều qua đây
    location /api/ {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:4000;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_read_timeout 300s;
        client_max_body_size 500m;  # Quan trọng: cho phép upload chunk lớn
    }

    # Socket.io proxy (WebSocket)
    location /socket.io/ {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:4001;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_read_timeout 86400s;
    }

    # Local storage public files (khi dùng local storage thay R2)
    location /storage/public/ {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:4000;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }

    # SPA fallback
    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }

    # Cache static assets (Vite hashed filenames)
    location ~* \.(js|css|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|ico|svg|woff|woff2|ttf|eot)$ {
        expires 30d;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
    }

    gzip on;
    gzip_types text/plain text/css application/json application/javascript text/xml application/xml;
    gzip_min_length 1000;
}
```

## Bảo mật

### Upload Security

- **Không dùng presigned URL**: Tất cả upload (ảnh, avatar, QR) đều proxy qua API server. R2 credentials chỉ nằm trên server, client không bao giờ thấy R2 endpoint
- **Validate client-side**: File size (200MB), extension, empty file — hiển thị toast thay vì alert
- **Validate server-side**: File size, MIME type whitelist, extension whitelist, quota check
- **Chunk upload**: 10MB/chunk qua `/api/storage/upload-chunk`, Nginx cho phép `client_max_body_size 500m`

### Auth Security

- JWT access token: 15 phút, HttpOnly + SameSite=Strict cookie
- Refresh token: 7 ngày
- CORS: chỉ cho phép `https://bhquan.site`
- Rate limiting: Redis-based per endpoint
- Password: bcrypt hash, validate strength

### Headers

- `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`
- `X-Frame-Options: DENY`
- `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains`
- `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`
